properties.text: record_attendance_by_card must not allow unauthenticated card_id spoofing to record attendance for arbitrary users.
properties.assertion: forall call(anon, record_attendance_by_card, p_card_id): requires physical_card_presence(p_card_id) OR rate_limit(caller_ip)

properties.text: p_card_id parameter must be sanitized; parameterized query must prevent SQL injection in SECURITY DEFINER context.
properties.assertion: forall call(_, record_attendance_by_card, p_card_id): sql_parameterized(p_card_id) AND no_injection(p_card_id)

properties.text: SECURITY DEFINER function search_path must be restricted to attendance,member schemas only.
properties.assertion: record_attendance_by_card.search_path == ['attendance', 'member'] AND NOT includes('public')

properties.text: Concurrent record_attendance_by_card calls for same user must not corrupt toggle state (TOCTOU on last type).
properties.assertion: forall concurrent(c1, c2, same_user): serializable(c1, c2) => consistent_toggle_sequence(c1, c2)

properties.text: card_id must map to at most one user; duplicate card_id across users causes incorrect attendance attribution.
properties.assertion: forall card_id: count(attendance.users WHERE card_id = card_id) <= 1

properties.text: Exception handler must not expose SQLERRM internals to anon callers in error response JSON.
properties.assertion: forall exception(e) in record_attendance_by_card: response.message NOT contains(table_names, column_names, stack_trace)

properties.text: Card ID input must be normalized before lookup to prevent bypass via encoding variants (case, whitespace, encoding).
properties.assertion: forall call(_, record_attendance_by_card, p_card_id): normalize(p_card_id) == canonical_form(p_card_id)

properties.text: anon role must have zero privileges on all member schema tables after fix_security_permissions migration.
properties.assertion: forall t in [members, teams, member_team_relations, team_leaders, generation_roles]: privileges(anon, member.t) == {}

properties.text: anon role must have zero privileges on attendance.attendances, attendance.users, attendance.daily_logout_logs.
properties.assertion: forall t in [attendances, users, daily_logout_logs]: privileges(anon, attendance.t) == {}

properties.text: anon must retain only SELECT (not INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE) on attendance.temp_registrations.
properties.assertion: privileges(anon, attendance.temp_registrations) == {SELECT} AND NOT includes({INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE})

properties.text: All member schema tables must have both ENABLE and FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY after migration.
properties.assertion: forall t in member_tables: rls_enabled(t) AND rls_forced(t)

properties.text: All attendance schema tables must have FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY to prevent service key bypass.
properties.assertion: forall t in [attendances, users, temp_registrations, daily_logout_logs]: rls_forced(t)

properties.text: record_attendance_by_card must be the only EXECUTE grant to anon after permission tightening.
properties.assertion: count(functions WHERE has_execute(anon)) == 1 AND that_function == 'record_attendance_by_card'

properties.text: SECURITY DEFINER function must not allow anon to write to tables beyond attendance.attendances INSERT.
properties.assertion: forall op in record_attendance_by_card: write_ops(op) ⊆ {INSERT INTO attendance.attendances}

properties.text: RLS policies must exist for every table with FORCE RLS; otherwise all queries are denied (implicit deny).
properties.assertion: forall t WHERE rls_forced(t): exists policy(t) AND policy(t).permissive == true FOR required_ops

properties.text: Authenticated users reading team_leaders/generation_roles via USING(true) must not leak sensitive admin data.
properties.assertion: forall row in team_leaders ∪ generation_roles: no_sensitive_fields(row) OR field_level_access_control(row)

properties.text: Future tables in member/attendance schemas must not auto-grant privileges to anon (DEFAULT PRIVILEGES revoked).
properties.assertion: ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA member REVOKE ALL FROM anon AND same for attendance

properties.text: Anon RPC calls must be rate-limited to prevent attendance record flooding via automated card_id enumeration.
properties.assertion: forall caller_ip, window(60s): count(calls(caller_ip, record_attendance_by_card)) <= rate_limit_threshold

properties.text: Toggle logic must default first attendance to 'in' when no prior record exists for the user.
properties.assertion: forall user_id WHERE count(attendances(user_id)) == 0: next_type(user_id) == 'in'

properties.text: Attendance date must be derived from timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tokyo'; date and timestamp must be consistent.
properties.assertion: forall attendance(a): a.date == (a.timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tokyo')::date

properties.text: record_attendance_by_card must return well-formed JSON on all execution paths including exceptions.
properties.assertion: forall call(record_attendance_by_card): result IS valid_json AND has_key(result, 'success')

properties.text: display_name fallback must query auth.users only when member.members.display_name IS NULL.
properties.assertion: forall rpc_call: (display_name IS NULL) => fallback_to(auth.users.global_name) AND (display_name IS NOT NULL) => no_auth_query

properties.text: SECURITY DEFINER function must not allow cross-schema access beyond attendance and member schemas.
properties.assertion: record_attendance_by_card accesses only: attendance.*, member.members, auth.users (read-only fallback)

properties.text: RPC function runs as SECURITY DEFINER; callers must not influence execution path beyond p_card_id parameter.
properties.assertion: forall call(anon, record_attendance_by_card): caller_influence ⊆ {p_card_id} AND no_dynamic_sql(p_card_id)

properties.text: display_name column must exist in member.members after migration (IF NOT EXISTS ensures idempotent ADD).
properties.assertion: column_exists(member.members, 'display_name') == true
